title: Clean-sheet two-layer mass-conservative physical reduction discriminator
purpose: Test whether a training-free two-storage physical reduction can retain useful balance and lower-boundary fidelity over the exposed B01 development domain while avoiding nonlinear Richards solves, before investing in a MetaSWAP-like quasi-steady manifold.

literature_precedent.two_layer_integrated_Richards: He et al. (2021, Journal of Hydrology 602, 126797) and He et al. (2022, Journal of Hydrology 613, 128327): vertically averaged two-layer mass-conservative Richards approximations for root-zone/vadose-zone dynamics and dynamic water-table coupling.
literature_precedent.MetaSWAP: Van Walsum and Groenendijk MetaSWAP: precedent that reduced unsaturated-zone physics can be judged by purpose-dependent hydrological fidelity rather than numerical identity.
literature_precedent.inheritance_boundary: These are scientific precedents only. D5 uses a clean-sheet formulation frozen below and does not copy implementation code, calibration tables or tuned coefficients from either family.

authority.R16_reference: Regenerated through the exact D4 research reference harness and integrated-mass numerical authority on the current canonical base.

constitutive_relations.effective_saturation: Se=(theta-theta_r)/(theta_s-theta_r), valid only for theta_r < theta < theta_s
constitutive_relations.extrapolation: none; any state outside open physical theta bounds is fail-closed

sign_and_flux_convention.equilibrium_check: Uniform pressure head with prescribed flux qeq_native=-K(theta0) gives q_top=q_12=q_bottom=+K(theta0) in the model convention.

time_integration.method: single explicit Heun predictor-corrector per declared observation interval
time_integration.predictor_gate: predictor theta for both layers must remain strictly within (theta_r,theta_s)
time_integration.corrected_gate: corrected theta for both layers must remain strictly within (theta_r,theta_s)
time_integration.terminal_bottom_flux_cm_per_day: q_bottom evaluated from corrected end state

seed.seed_forcing: same gravity-consistent prescribed top/bottom flux used by the R16 research harness
seed.seed_rule: run the same fixed Heun method for the two seed intervals; any drift is reported and must satisfy the same physical and hard mass gates

computational_structure.constitutive_evaluations_per_interval: fixed finite count from one Heun predictor-corrector plus terminal diagnostic
computational_structure.interpretation: Structural cost is used only for architecture discrimination. Formal end-to-end timing requires later same-language/current-runtime implementation on an admitted performance host.

preexisting_comparators.C2: Retained only as a local data-driven comparator where its frozen domain covers; D5 does not retune or reuse C2 blind evidence.

integrity_kill: predictor or corrected theta outside open B01 physical bounds
absolute transaction mass residual above 1e-12 cm
any hidden clipping, correction, adaptive substep or full-order fallback
positive_rule: and L2_IMC is non-dominated versus the pre-existing R2 comparator on at least one declared development view
balance view: both total-storage RMSE and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE <= R2 values, with no nonlinear Richards solve
or transient view: terminal bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and sign-error count <= R2, with no nonlinear Richards solve

purpose_dependent_boundary.LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE: D5 may retain or reject architecture candidacy but cannot establish application acceptance.
purpose_dependent_boundary.OPERATIONAL_SOIL_MOISTURE_DROUGHT: NOT_TESTED because root uptake, ET stress and drought memory are absent.
purpose_dependent_boundary.GROUNDWATER_COUPLED_MANY_COLUMN: Can only remain a candidate if bottom-flux sign/reversal evidence is not catastrophically degraded; qualification requires later coupled evidence.
purpose_dependent_boundary.FAST_EVENT_THRESHOLD: No qualification can be established from D5.
purpose_dependent_boundary.SCIENTIFIC_PROCESS_OR_EXTREME_INFERENCE: No qualification; two layer averages intentionally remove profile detail.

successor_logic.if_positive: Carry L2_IMC with R8/R4/R2 into purpose-specific validation and later same-runtime performance comparison. A MetaSWAP-like quasi-steady manifold is optional only if it can plausibly improve fidelity/domain/cost.
successor_logic.if_negative_but_integrity_passes: Proceed to a separately preregistered quasi-steady/storage-flux manifold because two instantaneous layer states are insufficient.
successor_logic.if_integrity_fails: Close L2_IMC. Do not add clipping, adaptive substeps or calibration after exposure; move to a different physical-reduction architecture.
